basic_info.description: Victorian Charm Meets Modern Ease in Prime Location!  This beautifully renovated 1-bedroom + office home offers the perfect blend of classic detail and contemporary comfort in one of San Francisco's most walkable neighborhoodswhere Mission meets Noe Valley. Just steps from Valencia and 24th Street, enjoy easy access to cafes, shops, and dining.    Inside, soaring ceilings, original trim, and a stunning built-in hutch are complemented by an open floor plan, recessed lighting, and a south-facing living room that fills the space with natural light. The eat-in kitchen features quartz counters, custom cabinetry with pullouts, subway tile backsplash, and stainless appliances.    The spacious bedroom includes a walk-in Elfa closet system, while the bonus room is ideal as an office, gym, or guest space. Enjoy the fully remodeled bathroom with designer finishes, new flooring throughout, in-unit laundry, and a 1-car parking with 240V EV charging.    Modern living with Victorian soulright where you want to be.
